note: Frozen snapshot, synced from SOPIA at the instant above. It is immutable: a later sync writes a NEW dated file beside this one rather than editing it, so this keeps its single-commit freeze while the set tracks the source. Carried so cai works from a single download with nothing else reachable.

re-root.summary: Carry a session's context forward past a compaction, into a new transcript.
re-root.why: A summary loses what was not selected; a re-root carries what was said. Measured: the re-root held a reasoned ruling under every degradation applied, and the summary lost it with none.

steps.check: the start is a clean top-level user record, and the arc's premise is inside it
steps.why: starting after the premise means the root must assert what the successor could have watched being decided

steps.check: thinking blocks excluded; the token count fits the target
steps.why: 3.9M raw becomes 281k as conversation; thinking is the largest component and its signatures do not validate outside the session that minted them
a malformed record reaching a projects directory crashes the client on load, and by then a backup is a recovery rather than a prevention
it is the only artifact recording what was lost, written at the moment of loss by the thing that did the losing

steps.check: the notice states where it starts and where it stops
steps.why: a suffix is a window, not a tail; a successor reading `runs to the end` believes it is current

steps.check: the destination is named for the sessionId in the records
steps.why: reading the id off a filename installs under a name that disagrees with the contents

steps.check: the resume command is given to a person
steps.why: resuming is a human step, and the first prompt is the operator's to scope

commit.summary: Land a change, having verified what the change depended on.
commit.why: Every commit failure in one session was the same shape: the commit ran without verifying what it depended on.

steps.check: the anchor matched exactly once and the structure count is as declared
steps.why: an anchor matching zero times leaves a message describing work the diff does not contain
three commits carried failing tests because the run and the commit were separate statements in one shell line

steps.check: staged diff non-empty, verification passing, grant in force
steps.why: the gate refuses rather than reporting afterwards

steps.check: the push grant is in force in its own right
steps.why: a commit is local and reversible; a push is outward-facing

sync.summary: Take a dated snapshot of what SOPIA defines, so cai works from one download.

steps.why: a sync that invented content would fabricate the very thing it was meant to preserve

steps.check: each snapshot carries what it copied and when
steps.why: identity comes from the content, which is why the single-commit rule is not applied here
a freeze claim from outside a frozen directory is refused rather than believed

enroll.summary: Decide how strongly a repository is held to cai.

steps.check: the question was put and answered
steps.why: a tool that picked a default would make the choice by omission

steps.check: strong pre-flights, and refuses if the hooks could not succeed
steps.why: strong enrollment should never brick a repository, so that is an impossible ask
hooks live in .git and do not survive a clone; the marker does
